evidence: Only caller 0x005E3EF8; validates/follows the handle in self->f_25c (g_005D39B0/0x005D39B4), reads the tracked unit's position/rotation at +0x1c..+0x2c, optionally adds the offset matrix g_005D39C0 through func_00633CAC, then calls func_00214038(global->f_10->f_b8, 0, &pos, &matrix) (Battle_TextWindow_UpdateVisibilityAlt) or func_00213E94 (Battle_TextWindow_UpdateVisibility) when the handle is lost.
